correctness.rationale: Source arXiv:2611.15943v1 proves the F5-resolution and projective big model, b2(B)=43 and b3(B)=0 and #B(F25)=43576. New direct counts give #Y(F5)=256 and exceptional corrections +30,+5,+10,+35, giving #B(F5)=336. Hard Lefschetz and F25 Weil saturation force 43 F5 Frobenius H2 eigenvalues ±5; F5 trace 35 yields multiplicities 25,18. Blowing up an F5-rational (-1,-1) curve contributes one +5 in H2, leaving 24,18 for the small model. Verified integer arithmetic for F5 and F25 from independent field representations. Purity and cohomology, not finite experiments alone, establish all extension-degree claims.

value.rationale: A complete zeta function of a natural newly constructed nonliftable Calabi–Yau self-product is an exact geometric-arithmetic invariant beyond its cohomological Betti numbers. The unusual III/IV/nonsplit I5 fiber corrections determine the missing base-field Frobenius signs, producing a useful explicit all-extension arithmetic profile and separating the underlying self-product question from the Kummer quotient. It is not an arbitrary slice or a recomputation of the known exceptional cubic zeta.
